import re

# --- Get Simple Note access token ---
sn_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0]['password']
sn_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='pa_ritter@gmail.com', password=sn_pw)
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']

# --- Fetch movie recommendations note ---
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2705, access_token=sn_token)
content = note['content']

# Extract movie titles from the note (lines that are not headers/blank/bullets)
titles=[]
for ln in content.splitlines():
    t = ln.strip()
    if not t or t.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if t.startswith('-'):
        continue
    titles.append(t)

msg = ', '.join(titles)
print('movie_titles_count', len(titles))
print('message_preview', msg[:120])

# --- Login to phone app ---
phone_pw = [p for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]['password']
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='2444880289', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']

# --- Find Leslie contact (loop through pages) ---
leslie_contacts=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Leslie', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print('contacts_page', page_index, 'count', len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    leslie_contacts.extend(res)
    page_index += 1

# Choose contact with first_name == 'Leslie'
leslie = None
for c in leslie_contacts:
    if c.get('first_name')=='Leslie':
        leslie = c
        break
if not leslie:
    # fallback to first match
    leslie = leslie_contacts[0]

print('chosen_leslie', leslie['first_name'], leslie['phone_number'])

# --- Send text message ---
send_resp = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=leslie['phone_number'], message=msg, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_resp', send_resp)
